rationale: No authoritative Phase24/Phase25A inference precision/batch contract is explicitly frozen (Phase25A trained with AMP but never froze an OOF/eval precision). A contract is therefore frozen prospectively here, BEFORE any DeltaDice is inspected, to avoid any outcome-driven choice.

binding.amp_rationale: AMP kernel selection depends on batch MEMBERSHIP; FP32 removes that non-determinism so OOF inference is a pure function of the sample.
binding.sample_order: deterministic: sort by dataset/domain then sample_id
binding.refiner_input_construction: [R,G,B] = rgb_crop(uint8)/255.0 float32 ; [p_global_crop] = prob_crop float16 -> float32  (exact BARRRefinerCropDataset train=False path)
